O.outcome_detail: performance test two weeks after learning

cells.quote: While a null effect of font manipulation was found immediately, two weeks later a clear performance advantage for disfluent fonts was observed.

Given that Weissgerber and Reinhard (2017) found no immediate disfluency effect but a delayed one, while Weltman and Eakin ( 2014) found a disfluency advantage, this misclassification is problematic and decreases the trustworthiness of the moderator analysis.
cells.note: The study text does not specify the exact outcome measure, timing, setting, participant expertise, age, or assignment design for Weltman and Eakin (2014).
